name: Shipping Info
summary: Passive native list of text-complete service or policy facts with optional decorative visuals and intrinsic responsive layout.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native unordered list grouping one or more source-ordered service facts.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item containing one valid target-owned service fact.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional decorative item visual; adjacent visible text owns the complete meaning.

behavior.name: itemComposition
behavior.description: The target supplies one or more source-ordered native list items with a required visible label, optional supporting text, and an optional decorative visual.

behavior.name: responsiveComposition
behavior.description: Intrinsic tracks respond to component inline space without changing, duplicating, or visually reordering items.

behavior.name: omission
behavior.description: Missing required items or the absence of every valid labelled item omits the complete root rather than rendering an empty shell.

properties.name: items
properties.description: One or more source-ordered target-owned native list items, each with a required visible label and optional supporting text and decorative visual.

accessibility: Render the meaningful group as a native ul/li list and retain list semantics when list markers are visually suppressed.
Require a non-empty visible label for every rendered item and omit invalid label-less target records.
Keep every optional visual decorative because adjacent visible text owns the complete service or policy meaning.
Responsive layout changes preserve DOM source and reading order and never make passive items focusable.
Add no section landmark, custom ARIA widget role, Arrow-key model, live region, timer, observer, request, authored motion, or neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Merchant-editable section maps reorderable labelled fact blocks, optional supporting text, optional decorative images, strict omission, editor attributes, and zero component runtime.
